description: A suppose block applies a change hypothetically and keeps its answer
code:
reading = 40
alarm = reading > 90
peak = suppose reading = 95: alarm
assert(peak, true)
assert(alarm, false)
reading

description: Rules propagate inside a suppose block before it is discarded
code:
price = 10
tax = price * 0.2
total = price + tax
suppose price = 50:
    assert(tax, 10)
    assert(total, 60)
total

description: An instance created in a suppose block leaves the population afterwards
code:
class Task(hours):
    this.hours = hours
Task(5)
load = Task.reduce((sum, task) -> sum + task.hours, 0)
projected = suppose Task(8): [Task.length, load]
assert(projected, [2, 13])
[Task.length, load]

description: An assigned suppose block keeps a snapshot that later changes leave alone
code:
rate = 0.1
balance = 100
interest = balance * rate
doubled = suppose rate = 0.2: interest
rate = 0.05
[doubled, interest]

description: A method returns an answer computed in a hypothetical world
code:
class Account(balance):
    this.balance = balance
    def after(deposit):
        suppose this.balance += deposit: return this.balance * 2
acct = Account(10)
assert(acct.after(5), 30)
acct.balance

description: A suppose block without a premise can start with a loop over instances
code:
class Item(price):
    this.price = price
Item(2)
Item(3)
sum = Item.reduce((total, item) -> total + item.price, 0)
discounted = suppose:
    for item of Item:
        item.price = item.price / 2
    sum
[discounted, sum]

description: The name suppose stays an ordinary variable beside suppose blocks
code:
suppose = 4
twice = suppose * 2
answer = suppose suppose = 10: twice
[answer, twice]
